A fairly quick edit of Overgrown Flowery Interface by Maraluna7 to match into 1.6!
Includes:
New Digspots adjusted to be white flowers(potentially changed later)
All UI changed to match

There is a line on the skills page that seems to be hardcoded, so until there is a further fix, it is stuck that way, unfortunately.
Feel free to report any issues to me and I will do my best to fix it! Also open to edit suggestions!
